query: WITH demographic_groups AS ( SELECT gender, nationality, person_type, COUNT(DISTINCT id, dependent_seq_no) AS group_count FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala WHERE snapshot = '2026-02-01' AND is_in_population = true GROUP BY gender, nationality, person_type ) SELECT gender, nationality, person_type, group_count, ROUND((group_count * 100.0) / SUM(group_count) OVER (), 2) AS percentage FROM demographic_groups ORDER BY nationality, person_type, gender LIMIT 20
